title: THE SYMMETRIC PHASE: chat 1's reframing checked against the record
claim_one_line: Chat 1's 'symmetric phase / broken phase' reframing (philosophy/P023), checked against the record: (1) its absence claim is false -- the whole phrase 'symmetric phase' is in the same three files on every head read (OPEN_LEADS L17, B849, B853) and 'broken phase' in S074 and B796's harvest; (2) its frame is already the record's -- B849 (2026-08-02) and the audit lane's F14, R48 and PB-CHIRAL; (3) its three kinds cover 14 of the chirality chain's 26 negatives (symmetry 8, flatness 3, non-uniqueness 3), and the other 12 (nine frame-arithmetic, B1373, B1501, B1503) are of none of them, two carrying curvature; (4) its critical point is xB032's entropy, 2 log phi (2 log(1 + sqrt 2) on the silver states), the Hagedorn abscissa of a free gas of periodic orbits (zeta and Euler product exact to order 40), and the monodromy's own thermodynamics has no broken mirror phase at any beta: K = [[0,1],[-1,0]] conjugates each of +-LR, +-LLRR to its inverse and Sinai-Ruelle-Bowen uniqueness makes the equilibrium state of a mirror-symmetric Hoelder potential mirror-symmetric; (5) in the bare flat model the symmetric split configuration is the minimum (R76, F01, main's B1455), and the one non-split configuration the record holds is held by a boundary (R81); (6) on m135 the class index is an exact order parameter for the dualising Z/2 (split (0,0), W1 (-1,-1), W2 (+1,+1))

the lemma of section 4.3 is about the monodromy's own thermodynamic formalism with Hoelder potentials (hyperbolic toral automorphisms conjugate to their inverses in SL(2, Z)); nothing about interacting orbit gases, non-Hoelder potentials or other dynamics
'Hagedorn point' names the abscissa of convergence of the orbit gas's partition function; it is not identified with a physical temperature
the dynamics of section 5 is the audit lane's (R76, F01, R41, R81) and main's B1455, quoted at source, not re-derived here
no open outcome is computed; nothing is sealed; no physical claim

sources.cite: M. Baake, E. Lau, V. Paskunas, A note on the dynamical zeta function of general toral endomorphisms, Monatsh. Math. 161 (2010) 33-42, arXiv:0810.1855
sources.says: a_m = |det(1 - M^m)|; zeta = exp(sum a_m z^m/m) = prod (1 - z^m)^(-c_m) with c_m the cycle numbers; zeta = prod_k det(1 - delta z Lambda^k M)^(eps (-1)^(k+1)), delta = sgn det(1 + M), eps = delta sgn det(1 - M)

sources.cite: V. Climenhaga, T. Fisher, D. J. Thompson, Equilibrium states for Mane diffeomorphisms, arXiv:1703.05722
sources.where: section 1, p. 1 (refs [9] Bowen LNM 470, [36] Ruelle Amer. J. Math. 98 (1976), [39] Sinai)
sources.says: Sinai, Ruelle and Bowen showed that a mixing Anosov diffeomorphism has a unique equilibrium state for every Hoelder continuous potential

sources.cite: T. Kucherenko, A. Quas, Asymptotic behavior of the pressure function for Hoelder potentials, arXiv:2302.14839
sources.says: for mixing subshifts of finite type the pressure is real analytic on Hoelder potentials and each has one Gibbs state, the only equilibrium state; Bowen carried this to Anosov diffeomorphisms through Markov partitions

sources.cite: J. Springham, Ergodic properties of linked-twist maps (PhD thesis, Bristol 2008), arXiv:0812.0899
sources.says: the cat map, and with it any hyperbolic toral automorphism, is ergodic, mixing and Bernoulli

sources.cite: K. Redlich, H. Satz, The Legacy of Rolf Hagedorn: Statistical Bootstrap and Ultimate Temperature, arXiv:1501.07523
sources.says: an exponentially growing spectrum makes the partition function diverge beyond T_H; whether T_H is a limiting temperature or a transition depends on the spectrum's prefactor and, beyond the limit, on more information (QCD)

prior_work.why: the frame is the record's (B849, the audit lane's F14/R48/PB-CHIRAL), the number is xB032's, the zeta identities are Baake-Lau-Paskunas' and the uniqueness is Sinai-Ruelle-Bowen's; this arc adds the record-by-record reading of chat 1's three kinds against the chain's 26 negatives, the reading of xB032's entropy as the Hagedorn abscissa of a free orbit gas, the no-broken-mirror-phase lemma for the golden and silver monodromies (K conjugates each to its inverse), and B1530's member as an exact order parameter for the dualising Z/2
